svg.title: Two valid Barents lines answer two different questions
svg.desc: A 43-face wet-ended Fugloya-Bear observational proxy is compared with a 73-face coast-to-coast Norway-Svalbard model closure. Both pass native C-grid topology checks but their endpoints and meanings differ.
svg.metadata: Surface face-path geometry only. No state variables, face thickness, transport, heat, Atlantic Water class, observational agreement, or Arctic delivery is calculated.
svg.text: TWO VALID LINES. TWO DIFFERENT QUESTIONS.
Topology can certify a face path. It cannot make unlike endpoints measure the same domain.

g.text: virtual wet endpoints preserve comparison with the named section
OPEN PROXY · MODEL WATER CAN BYPASS THE ENDS
modeled coast at both ends; northern endpoint is 243 km from Bear target
BUDGET CLOSURE · NOT THE OBSERVATIONAL BSO

svg.text: BOTH PATHS PASS THE SAME TOPOLOGY CONTRACT
SQUARE = U FACE · CIRCLE = V FACE · SURFACE GEOMETRY ONLY · NO VELOCITY, VOLUME, HEAT, OR OBSERVATIONAL AGREEMENT · PUBLIC ORAS5 ORCA025 MESH
